h1: Every perfume branch ready for Eid season
lead: Ramadan and Eid are the busiest selling days and customers look for a branch open late at night. SAAYT keeps every branch’s hours and photos right

pains.d: Extended Ramadan and Eid-night hours differ between mall and street
Checking each branch one by one takes time you do not have in season
Reviews about staff or gift wrapping need a reply that protects the brand

helps.d: Ramadan and Eid-night hours for every branch from one template
Showroom and new-release photos in every branch
Refined replies in your brand voice
Spot which branch needs support before the season

example.review: The oud the staff recommended is amazing and the gift wrapping was perfect
example.reply: Thank you for your refined taste. We are delighted you loved the oud and that the gift was presented as it deserves. It is always an honour to welcome you
example.note: A refined tone that fits the brand
